abstract: Ovarian pregnancy is a rare form of ectopic gestation. Mature cystic teratoma is the most common form of germ cell tumor, and usually occurs in the reproductive age group. The concomitant occurrence of an ovarian pregnancy with a mature cystic teratoma in the same ovary is exceedingly rare. We were able to find two other such cases in the literature. We present a case, and discuss the entity.
abstract_ja: 卵巣妊娠は稀な異所性妊娠の一形態です。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は最も頻度の高い胚細胞腫瘍で、通常は生殖年齢の女性に発生します。同一卵巣内で卵巣妊娠と成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が同時に生じることは極めて稀です。文献上、このような症例は他に2例しか見つかりませんでした。本症例を提示し、この病態について考察します。
